tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// rgyal bu ji big de mur la gtam du bya ba nor bu'i phreng ba bzhugs// ༄༅// rgyal bu ji big de mur la gtam du bya ba nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams rgya mtshor rab tu 'khrungs// ye shes tshogs kyis che ba'i sku// dpag yas yon tan gyis brgyan pa'i// rgyal ba lhun po la phyag 'tshal// dge ba rgya mtsho'i gling du 'khrungs// rigs gzugs 'byor pa'i gzi brjid ldan// rang srid rnam par skyong ba'i dpal// rgyal bu rin chen rgyal gyur cig /tshul khrims dag pa'i gzhi ston zhing*// mang du thos pa'i chu gter can// yon tan rin chen tshogs 'dzin pa// 'phags pa'i blo yi rgya mtsho las// byung ba'i spring yig nor bu'i phreng*// phyogs kun gsal ba'i 'od 'byin zhing*// bdag gzhan mdzes pa bskyed pa'i rgyan// bsam pa dge bas ring nas 'bul// khyod kyi dpal 'byor phun tshogs phyir// nor gyi skyes kyis ci zhig bgyi// dgung zla'i 'od kyis kun+da ltar// gsal bar bgyi slad chos skyes 'bul// gang la 'di dpal phun tshogs kyang*// chos dpal rnam par mi ldan na// dug bcas kha zas bzang za bzhin// sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig bskyed pa lags// gang zhig chos kyi dpal ldan yang*// 'jig rten dpal gyis dben gyur na// shun pa bcas pa'i rin chen ltar// gzhan gyi don du 'gyur ma lags// gang la de gnyis phun tshogs na// gnyis ka'i don chen 'grub 'gyur te// thabs kyis zin pa'i rin po ches// rang gzhan mdzes par bgyid pa ltar// de slad nyid la tshul gnyis kyi// dpal dang ldan pa gang lags pa// kun nas 'bras bu mchis bgyi'i slad// 'di brjod pa la rtse gcig dgongs// nyi ma'i 'od dang rgya mtsho'i klong*// lhun po'i brtan pa gang lags pa'ang*// dus mthar nyams par 'gyur lags na// 'gro ba'i 'byor pa smos ci 'tshal// 'di 'dra mkhyen pas khyod dpal gyis// khyod thugs dregs par mi 'gyur zhing*// dpal gyis dpal yang 'phel bgyi'i slad// rtag tu bag yod bsten 'tshal lo// sdug bsngal ba yis thugs 'byung dang*// bde ba'ang 'gyur ba'i chos can dang*// kun kyang kun 'byung las byung dang*// de yis de rgyu mdzad bgyid par// khyod kyis rtag tu dgongs bgyis nas// bdag dang gzhan gyi gdung bas thugs// kun nas nyon mongs mi 'gyur zhing*// dge ba'i rkyen du 'gyur bar mdzod// tshogs dang smon lam mthun pa'i mthus// dngos dang brgyud pas nyid kyi sku// bskyed bgyis yab yum brgyud bcas kyi// bka' drin dgongs par mdzod cig dang*// tshul lugs dge ba spyad pa'i phyir// gdung brgyud chu bo lta bu dang*// de dag nyid la 'dun pa dang*// dgongs pa'ang ji bzhin bsgrub 'gyur lags// gang gi dpal la mngon brten nas// de yi bka' drin nos gyur pa'i// rgyal ba gtsug gi nor bu bzhin// rtag tu bkur bar mdzod cig dang*// de ni nyid la rin chen ltar// bzhed dgu ma lus stsol 'gyur zhing*// nyid kyang 'gro ba gzhan dag gis// bkur 'os nyid du 'gyur ba lags// rigs kyi nang nas rgan pa dang*// smra ba'i nang nas bden smra dang*// gzhung lugs nang nas 'thad ldan dang*// brtul zhugs ldan las gzhan phan can// nor gyi nang nas rig pa dang*// ya rabs nang nas yon ldan ldan// dman pa'i nang nas nyams thag dang*// nyams thag nang nas nad pa dang*// chung ma'i nang nas rjes 'brang dang*// bu yi nang nas rig 'dzin dang*// gnyen gyi nang nas mi slu dang*// grogs kyi nang nas phan 'dogs dang*// bran gyi nang nas bsgo ba nyan// phan btags nang nas drin gzo dang*// gnod bgyid nang nas bzod gnas dang*// kun gyi nang nas glo bur lhags// de dag rnams la der dgongs nas// bkur dang bskyang bar mdzod cig dang*// skye bo gzhan yang des rkyen gyis// tshul ldan las la 'jug 'gyur lags// nya pa dang ni shan pa sogs// gzhan la 'tshe ba de dag gis// bdag gi don yang mi 'grub na// gzhan don smos kyang ci zhig 'tshal// slob ma rgyal sras rgyal ba rnams// gzhan gyi don gyi khyad par gyis// tha ma 'bring dang mchog gi tshul// brnyes pa lkog gyur lags mod kyang*// nyung ngu 'bring dang mang po la// nye bar phan pa don gnyer bas// chung ngu 'bring dang chen po yi// gtso bor gyur pa ma gzigs sam// de slad lus can ji snyed la// khyed thugs brtse bar rigs lags na// nyid la brten pa'i skye bo la// brtse bar rigs pa smos ci 'tshal// nyid la rten dang srog ldan par// nyid kyis 'gro rnams mtshungs bzhin du// la la bkums nas gzhan 'ga' zhig

/tshim bgyid chos kyi tshul ma lags// gnod pa med par mang po'i yid// dga' bgyid rtse 'jo'i sbyor lags pas// skyo ba bsal phyir dus bab tshe// khyod kyis rol par rigs lags kyang*// skye bo log par goms pa'i yid// gnas skabs dga' phyir mang po la// 'tshe bgyid brtags na mya ngan rgyur// khyed kyis mkhyen par mdzad nas spongs// rang gis nongs par spyad bzhin du// gzhan gyi tshig rtsub mi bzod par// nongs med sems can 'gums bgyid pa// 'di las 'gal ba gzhan ci mchis// gzhan la brtse bas bdag 'dun dang*// gzhan bskyangs pa yis bdag mchod dang*// snyan par smra bas bdag bstod pa// tshul 'di dngos po'i chos lags pas// byang chub don du brtse ba dang*// phan par bsgrub pa lta zhog gi /'jig rten don du gnyer bas kyang*// de 'drar rigs pa ma lags sam// de ltar dgongs nas gzhan dag la// phan dang brtse bar mdzod cig dang*// 'di dang phyi ma'i bdag gzhan don// ma lus 'grub par 'gyur lags grang*// tshe dang dpal dang chos 'phel na// 'o brgyal dang du blang bgyi ste// bzlog na bzlog pa'ang bzlog pa ru// khyod kyis nan tan mdzad 'tshal lo// nor gyis 'khor bsrung 'khor gyi lus// de yi srog dang thams cad kyis// dam chos bsrung zhes dam pa rnams// gsung gis kun nas dgongs par mdzod// chos dang 'jig rten don 'ga' zhig /gnas skabs la lar ma grub kyang*// nyid thugs ldog par mi bgyi ste// tshong dang zhing pa'i tshul la gzigs// bsgrub bya'i don chen cig car du// 'grub pa shin tu dka' lags kyang*// rim gyis bsgrubs na 'grub dka' ba'ang*// 'grub par 'gyur te grog mkhar bzhin// bya ba rgya chen bsgrub pa la// 'gal bgyid gcig kyang mang pa ste// dug dang ldan pa'i mda' gcig gis// 'gro ba srog dang bral bar bgyid// phan bgyid rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed kyang*// mangs par gyur pa ma lags te// rgyal srid ji tsam yangs gyur pa'i// rgyal po'ang chen po ma lags sam// thabs dang ldan na gnod bgyid pa'ang*// bdag gi dpung du 'gyur ba ste// glang chen khros pa lcags kyu yis// btul nas 'khor bar blo ldan bgyid// drag shul sbyor bas dgra bo rnams// gdul zhes 'jig rten smra lags kyang*// zhi bas zhi bar 'gyur lags te// me la me dang chu bzhin no// rtsub mos gnod byed gcig bcom yang*// slar zhing mang bar 'gyur lags te// gram pa'i khrod kyi zug rngu'i rdo// bsal na ji ltar 'gyur ba dgongs// thabs kyis de dag dbang bgyis na// mang bzhin bdag phyogs brtan 'gyur te// brag ri brtsegs par gnas bcas pa'i// gnas khang brling ba ma lags sam// de ltar phyogs gzhan dbang bgyis nas// nyid kyi chab 'og mchis pa rnams// kun nas chos bzhin bskyang bgyi ste// chos kyis 'jig rten bde bgyi slad// byams dang snyan par smra ba dang*// go 'phang 'tsham bar stsol ba dang*// zang zing lhug par stsal ba yis// srid 'bangs bskyang bar mdzod cig dang*// ji ltar bskyangs pa las byung ba'i// dpal 'byor bskrun pa gang lags pa// de kun nyid kyi dpal 'gyur zhing*// 'du ba'i sgo mor 'du lags te// ji lta ji ltar zhing pa yis// zhing la so nam 'bad bgyis pa// de lta de ltar ston thog kyang*// de yis thob pa ma lags sam// srid 'bangs nyid du mtshungs lags kyang*// log dang legs par bgyis pa la// tshar gcad rjes 'dzin bgyi 'tshal te// lus kyi nad dang zungs bzhin no// tshar gcad pa la spyo ba dang*// brdeg dang phrog dang ngan smad pas// sun 'byin bgyid par rigs lags kyi// srog dang bral bgyid de ltar min// dri ma dag dang bcas pa'i gos// bkrus nas spyod bgyid mkhas pa ste// bsregs nas med par bgyis pa la// mdzangs pa lags zhes su zhig gleng*// go 'phang 'tsham par stsal bgyi ste// bzlog na bzlog par 'gyur du mchi// chung ngu khye'u nar son la// kha zas sbyor ba'i tshul la dgongs// yon tan med dang skyon med pa// 'jig rten 'di na mchis ma lags// shas che ba dang gnas skabs la// brtags nas blang dang dor bgyi ste// du bar bcas pa'i sgron me dang*// myangs na zhim pa'i dug dang ni// thang dang chu la bgrod pa la// shing rta dang ni gru bzhin no// longs spyod tshul bzhin mkhyen bgyi ste// dgra dang gnyen du gyur pa dang*// de bzhin don med gyur pa dang*// bzhi pa longs spyod nyid gyur lags// tshol dang bsags pas dang po dang*// bskyed dang bsrung bas bar dang ni// ngang gis gnod dang 'thab rtsod kyis// tha mar gnod 'gyur longs spyod dgra// legs par rnyed dang lhun grub pa'i// dngos po dag pa dge ba'i blos// mchod dang sbyin par bgyis pa yi// longs spyod phan pa bskyed phyir gnyen// phan gnod med par thob pa gang*// sbyin dang spyod par mi byed par// rtag tu 'jog dang chud zos pa'i// longs spyod de ni don med lags// thog mar ji ltar rnyed kyang rung*// bdag dang gzhan gyis spyad bgyis pas// gnas skabs bde bar bgyid pa gang*// de ni longs spyod gyur pa lags// de dag rnams las dang po dang*// gsum pa rtag tu spang bgyi ste// gnyis pa kun tu spyod bgyi zhing*// bzhi pa ci rigs dag tu mdzod// chog shes med par longs spyod pa// sdug bsngal skyed par bgyid pa ste// lus zungs nyams dang ma zhu'i nad// gang las byung ba dgongs par mdzod// chang gis 'jig rten brnyas bgyid cing*// lus rgud blo gros nyams par bgyid// don nyams chos dang bral bgyid pas// chang la rtag tu dug bzhin gzigs// gzhan yang 'dod la chags pa yis// bsags pa'i dge ba 'dzad pa dang*// rtag tu bya ba nyams 'gyur bas// chog shes rtag tu bsten 'tshal lo// bya ba sgrub pa'i tshul yang ni// brtags nas bsgrub pa mdzangs pa ste// bsgrubs nas rtog pa blun po zhes// dam pa'i gzhung las 'byung lags pas// nyid kyi bgyi ba gang lags pa// brtags shing bgros nas mdzod cig dang*// don kun 'grub 'gyur gzhan du na'ang*// 'gyod pa med par 'gyur ba lags// mdor na 'byor dang rgud pa yis// dregs dang zhum mi 'gyur ba dang*// byas shes drin du gzo ba dang*// mchod 'os mchod dang dman pa skyong*// phyogs gzhan dbang du bgyi ba dang*// yul 'khor chos bzhin skyong ba dang*// longs spyod bag yod spyod pa dang*// bya ba mdzangs par bsgrub pa lags// de ltar bgyis pas 'jig rten 'dir// phun sum tshogs par gyur pa des// pha rol bde ba gnyer bgyi'i slad// bde ba'i lam la 'jug 'tshal lo// sna tshogs lam du khrid bgyid pa'i// ston pa rab tu mang mchis mod// rgyu dang bcas pa'i nyes bcom zhing*// yon tan yongs rdzogs mchog lags kyang*// bdag ni yon tan dman pa dang*// de bzhin skyon dang ldan no zhes// su yang smra ba mi bgyid pas// rang bzhin sems pa'i dpyod pa yis// de yi spyod dang des bstan pa'i// gzhung las de tshul 'tshal bgyi ste// gzhung gang ngag tshig dri ma med// tshad ma gnyis kyis nges par grub// 'gal dang ma 'brel rnam par spangs// gcig tu phan dang bder bgyid pa'i// gzhung lugs de ni dam pa ste// de 'dra gzhan la ltos med par// rang gi mthu yis 'byed bgyid pa'i// ston pa ston pa'i mchog lags pas// de yi gsung gi rjes 'jug pa'i// skye bo rnams kyang dam pa lags// de slad chos la yid ches nas// rdzogs sangs rgyas la rab dad pas// sras dang slob ma'i rjes 'jug pa// dpyod ldan dam pa lags pa'i phyir// nyid kyang sangs rgyas chos tshogs kyi// yon tan mkhyen nas dad pa dang*// 'jigs pa kun las skyob don du// ston pa lam dang grogs kyi phyir// ji srid 'tsho zhing gzhes gyi bar// skyabs kyi dam par gzung du gsol// de ni nyes kun sel ba dang*// yon tan kun gyi gzhi chen lags// de ltar skyabs mchog nyer bstan zhing*// bdud rtsi'i sgo mor zhugs pa des// rtag tu chos bzhin bgyi 'tshal te// de yi gzhi yang tshul khrims lags// bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa yis// nyin zhag dge bar mdzod cig dang*// tshul khrims dag la goms 'gyur zhing*// 'dod lhar mchis zhes rgyal bas gsungs// yang srid dag la mtshams sbyor ba'i// sred dang 'du 'dzi spang phyir dang*// kun spyod rnam par dag bgyi'i phyir// so sor thar pas bsdam par bgyi// yongs su rdzogs par mi spyod kyang*// ci rigs ci nas brten 'tshal te// tha na sna gcig spyod pas kyang*// nyid kyi brtul zhugs mdzes par mdzod// goms na dka' ba ma mchis par// dge ba ngang gis 'phel 'gyur lags// de yis shes bya thams cad la// mkhas shing rnam par grol bgyi'i phyir// rigs dang gzhung lugs sna tshogs pa// mang las mang du gsan pa dang*// gzigs dang gleng bar bgyi ba la// nyid thugs gzhol bar mdzod cig dang*// gtsug lag kun la mkhas pa dang*// bye brag rnam par phyed pa yis// blang dang dor bya'i 'jug ldog la// kun du 'khrul par 'gyur ma lags// khyad par dam chos tshul chen la// ngoms pa med par gsan bgyi ste// shes bya'i snying po lags phyir dang*// mkhyen rab dge ba 'phel 'gyur phyir// som nyi blo yis skyes bu'i don// 'grub par dka' ba gnas pa ltar// gsan yang de don ma nges na// don du 'gyur ba'ang rab dka' bas// khyod kyis gsan pa gang lags pa// yang dag rigs pas rnam dpyad na// don bzhin nges par 'gyur lags te// snang bcas gzugs la mig gis bzhin// de ltar gsan dang dpyod pa la// gzhol na nyung ngu nyung ngus kyang*// rim gyis mkhyen pa 'phel 'gyur te// bung bas sbrang rtsi ji bzhin no// 'di ni lung gi chos la dbang*// bsgyur bar bgyid pa'i thabs chen te// so nams las kyi ston thogs ltar// rtogs chos zas kyi rgyu chen lags// de yis srid pa'i sdug bsngal dang*// de rgyu las dang nyon mongs par// nges nas dge ba spel ba dang*// mi sdug pa dang byams pa dang*// rten 'byung khams kyi dbye ba dang*// dbugs dbyung rngub pa rjes dran dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos rnams la// so sor rtog cing mnyam 'jog pas// mtho ris bde la gnas bcas te// tshogs dang sbyor bas 'jig rten dang*// mthong dang sgom dang mthar phyin pas// 'jig rten 'das pa'i lam bgrod de// thabs dang sbyangs ba'i bye brag gis// ston dang slob ma'i rigs dang ni// yon tan dag gis rab phye ba'i// mya ngan 'das pa thob par 'gyur// 'di ni theg pa chung ngu yi// chos tshul mdo tsam smos pa ste// theg pa che la 'dzeg pa yi// skas dang 'dra bar 'gyur ba lags// theg pa chung ngu'i lugs bstan pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o//

//de ltar 'di dang pha rol gyi// bdag gi don la 'bad bgyis kyang*// gzhan gyi don gyi thabs chen las// nyams phyir sangs rgyas rgyang ring lags// gang zhig gzhan gyi don brtson na// gnyis ka'i don chen 'grub 'gyur gyi// gzhan don nyams pa'i rang don gyis// bdag don phun tshogs ga la srid// mang du smos kyang ci 'tshal te// rgyal srid skyong ba'i rgyal po dang*// gla rngan tsam gyis bdag skyong ba// 'di gnyis kyi ni khyad par gzigs// de slad gzhan don dga' ba yi// spyod pa rgya mtsho las byung ba'i// lus can kun gyi gnyen gcig pu// thams cad mkhyen pa brnyes bgyi'i slad// don gnyis brnyes pa'i rgyal ba dang*// de bsgrub bgyid pa'i theg chen dang*// phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun la// ston pa'i phyir dang mnyes bgyi'i phyir// bgrod bgyi'i phyir dang brtan bgyi'i phyir// grogs phyir 'khor du bsdu bgyi'i phyir// dgongs pa de dag brnyes kyi bar// lus can kun dang thabs cig pa'i// skyabs kyi dam par gzung du gsol// de ni bzhed dgu 'byung ba yi// byang chub sems kyi rin po che// nye bar bsgrub pa'i gzhir 'gyur zhing*// srid zhi'i dge gzhan zil gnon bgyid// sems la sems las ma gtogs pa'i// rgyu gzhan ma mchis skad cig gi /bdag nyid phyir na rgyu med pa'ang*// ma lags sems nyid sems kyi rgyu// de phyir sems la thog ma'i mtha'// rnam pa kun tu mchis ma lags// de ldan phyir na sems can lags// mkha' la pha mtha' ma mchis pa// 'jig rten khams kyang de dang mtshungs// de la brten pa'i sems can yang*// gzhal du med par mkhyen par mdzod// 'di ni byams brtse'i yul lags te// de dag so so'i las kyi mthus// mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal gyi// phung pos kun nas gdung 'gyur zhing*// lam gsum brgyud mar 'khor 'gyur bas// 'khor ba'i 'khor lo mgal me yi// 'khor lo ji bzhin 'khor 'gyur ba// 'di ni srid pa'i tshig bla dgas// de lta mod kyi de yi khams// chos kyi sku yi rang bzhin phyir// thabs dang ldan na de dag kun// sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur lags kyang*// goms dang bag chags dman phyir dang*// rkyen dman phyir dang grogs dman phyir// gzhan gyi don las nyams 'gyur zhing*// rang gi don yang ma rdzogs pa'i// grol ba tsam du mchi bgyid pa// 'di ni zhi ba'i tshig bla dgas// dgon par sprul pa'i grong khyer ltar// gnas skabs 'bras bu yin no zhes// thub pa'i dbang pos gsungs lags pas// rim gyis de dag rgyal bar mchi// srid zhi de dag 'jig rten dang*// 'jig rten 'das pa'i bde ba ni// dri med rgyu dang bcas pa la// rtag tu gnas 'dod byams pa lags// srid pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad dang*// theg pa dman dang de yi 'bras// gang la mchis de rgyur bcas pa// bral 'dod snying rje'i rnam pa lags// de slad tshul 'di byams pa dang*// rtag tu thugs rjer mdzad du gsol// de ltar byams brtse'i yid mchis kyang*// de yi thabs la mi 'jug dang*// 'jug kyang mthu dang mi ldan na// gzhan gyi don du 'gyur ma lags// de slad nyes kun sel ba dang*// yon tan kun la nyer sbyor ba'i// mthu stobs dam pa rab brnyes shing*// mkhyen dang brtse ba'i mthar son pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid lags la// de yang sems can las byung bas// bdag kyang de 'drar bya'o zhes// smon pa smon pa'i sems lags te// de yi dge ba'i bshes gnyen la// brten nas yan lag phun tshogs pa'i// cho gas de ltar dam bca' ba// smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed lags// sangs rgyas nyid ni 'grub byed pa'i// thabs tshul mtha' dag spyad do zhes// 'dun pa 'jug pa'i sems lags te// dam 'cha' 'jug pa'i sems bskyed lags// 'di ni ma bskyed bskyed pa'i thabs// skyes pa gong du 'phel bgyi'i phyir// spro ba chen pos smon pa dang*// rtsom pas 'jug pa mthar phyin mdzod// smon pa de yang 'gror 'dod dang*// 'jug pa 'gro ba lta bu'o zhes// rgyal sras 'ga' yis dper mdzad pa// smon 'jug bsgrub pa'i tshul la dgongs// de ltar sems dang sems bskyed dang*// bsgrub pas smon 'jug rab dbye ba'i// tshul 'di 'ga' zhig kho nas bshad// 'di ni kun rdzob byang chub sems// dpyad na dngos 'di du ma dang*// rjes 'brel phyir na gcig ma lags// gcig med pa la du ma gang*// de gnyis las gzhan yod par ci// yod pa med phyir med pa'ang gsog

/'gal phyir gnyis ka'ang gshis ma lags// sgrub byed med phyir gnyis min min// de phyir brtags na gnas med pas// blos kyang mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa// 'di ni don dam byang sems kyi// rgyu mthun nyid lags rnam kun gyi// mchog ldan lta ba'ang de nyid lags// 'dzin pa med par mnyam 'jog dang*// dpe dang gtan tshigs thams cad kyis// nges par bgyis pas don dam gyi// byang chub sems ni goms par bgyi// srid zhi'i nyes dmigs shes pa yi// der 'dun pa dang bral ba dang*// sangs rgyas yon tan rjes dran pas// rtag tu de la 'dun pa dang*// bdag gzhan mnyam dang brje ba yis// gzhan gyi don la spro ba dang*// mi zhum pa dang mi skyo bas// 'jug pa'i tshul la 'jug 'gyur ba// 'di ni byang chub smon pa'i sems// mthar phyin bgyid pa'i thabs chen lags// bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsgrub pa// 'jug pa mthar phyin bgyid pa ste// de yang rang gi sangs rgyas chos// rdzogs bgyid pha rol phyin pa drug /'di dag brtse bas kun bslang zhing*// 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog dang*// mi bshol chog mi shes pa dang*// gdul bya'i re ba yongs rdzogs shing*// de dag byang chub la sbyor ba// de ltar kun la ldan bgyis nas// dngos kun gtong bar 'dun pa yis// zang zing mi 'jigs chos byams pa// rigs pa'i tshul gyis stsal bgyid pa// 'di ni sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin// kha na ma tho med 'dun pas// nyes spong dge ba bsgrub pa dang*// gzhan gyi don la nyer sbyor ba// 'di ni tshul khrims pha rol phyin// 'khrug pa med par 'dun pa yis// mi mjed ji mi snyam pa dang*// nges par sems pas mi 'khrug pa// 'di ni bzod pa'i pha rol phyin// dge ba sdud par spro ba yis// go cha sbyor dang mi zhum dang*// mi 'khrug pa dang chog mi shes// 'di ni brtson 'grus pha rol phyin// yid mi g.yo bar 'dun pa yis// yul rnams kun la sems bsdus nas// sems la sems rab 'jog byed pa// 'di ni bsam gtan pha rol phyin// thams cad shes par 'dun pa yis// kun rdzob shes shing de dpyad pas// rang bzhin med par rab shes pa// 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin// rim bzhin ser sna tshul 'chal dang*// khro dang le lo rnam g.yeng dang*// mi shes pa yi gnyen po ste// nyes pa thams cad 'jig bgyid lags// 'byor dang bde 'gro gzugs bzang dang*// don kun grub dang yid zhi dang*// kun la kun nas mkhas gyur pa// gnas skabs kyi ni 'bras bu lags// dang po lnga yis bsod nams tshogs// rtag tu 'phel bar bgyid pa ste// de bzhin drug pa ye shes tshogs// yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pa lags// gzhan yang lnga pa zhi gnas dang*// drug pa lhag mthong gyur pa ste// yid ni zhi bar gnas pa dang*// dpyad na lhag don mthong bar bshad// snga mas nyon mongs zhi bgyid cing*// ting 'dzin mngon shes dag par bgyid// phyi mas nyes kun drung 'byin zhing*// shes rab ye shes yongs dag bgyid// tshul khrims gnyis ka'i gzhi lags te// lhag ma gsum ni 'grub pa'i rkyen// rnam par dpyad na re re la'ang*// drug dang gnyis ka ldan gyur pas// de slad re re'ang drug dang ni// gnyis gnyis ldan par mkhyen bgyis nas// rtag tu goms par mdzod cig dang*// de la sangs rgyas ring ma lags// sems can smin bgyid bsdus pa yi// dngos po rnam pa bzhi lags te// zang zing sbyin pas gdul bya kun// bos nas gnas skabs bde la dgod// snyan par smra bas pha rol phyin// yang dag ji bzhin yongs bshad nas// don spyod pa yis bshad pa yi// sbyor ba dag la nyer sbyar te// bdag nyid don mthun zhugs pa yis// don la spro ba bskyed par bgyi// dang po zang zing sgo nas te// gsum ni chos kyis sdud pa lags// de yang thog ma phan bgyid de// lhag ma gsum ni grol bgyid pas// gzhan gyi don gyi tshul thams cad// 'di yi khongs su 'du ba lags// de ltar tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang*// don gnyis dag la rab brtson pa'ang*// sgyu ma'i tshul gyis spyad bgyi zhing*// mi rtog rnal 'byor goms bgyis pas// dam pa rnams kyi spyod yul la// byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid can// sgrib pa med pa'i sems kyis ni// mngon sum du ni bgyid par 'gyur// bsod nams ye shes 'khor lo zung*// thabs la mkhas pa'i srog shing dang*// sdom pa rgya che'i rten dang ni// dran dang brtson 'grus ting 'dzin gyi// yan lag ldan pa'i rta mchog ni// rim bzhin gcig gnyis gsum dag dang*// smon lam kha lo sgyur byed sogs// tshogs par bgyis nas thar pa yi// cha mthun lam la 'jug bgyid pa// de ni tshogs kyi lam zhes bgyi// de lta'i shing rta cher zhugs nas// dbang po'i yan lag lnga ldan dang*// stobs kyi yan lag lnga ldan dang*// glang chen gcig gnyis rim sbyar bas// bgrod pas nges 'byed cha mthun gyi// lam la nye bar zhugs gyur nas// 'phags pa'i ye shes rgya mtsho cher// sbyor bas sbyor ba'i lam zhes bgyi// sa lam bgrod tshe'i mthong spang gi

/nyes tshogs tshang tshing rab spangs nas// rgya mtshor nam mkha'i mdangs lhung ltar// mnyam gzhag blo dang chos kyi dbyings// ro gcig ye shes rgya mtsho yi// byang chub yan lag rin po che// rnam pa bdun ldan 'jug ngogs mchog /sngon chad ma mthong des mthong zhing*// nye bar zhugs pa nyid kyi phyir// 'di ni mthong ba'i lam zhes bgyi// mi rtog ye shes gru bo che// 'phags lam yan lag ba dan sogs// rnam pa brgyad kyis nyer brgyan par// zhugs nas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis// dus kyi rlung dang rjes mthun par// chos dbyings zhi ba'i 'jug ngogs la// bgrod pas rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'dra'i// bsgoms pas spang ba'i nyes pa kun// spangs nas slob pa'i 'phags chos kyi// rin chen rnams la dbang sgyur bgyid// mthong don bsgoms pas goms bgyid pas// 'di ni bsgom pa'i lam zhes bgyi// de ltar sa dang rgya mtsho lta'i// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das lam las// nye bar brgal nas yid bzhin gyi// rin chen gling gi sgor zhugs mtshungs// bgrod pa'i lam gyi mthar son dang*// mi mthun phyogs kun 'joms pa dang*// yon tan mthar phyin bgyid pas na// mthar phyin pa yi lam zhes bgyi// 'jig rten 'das pa'i lam de yang*// sa bcu dag gis phye ba lags// ji ltar rgya mtsho'i chur mtshungs kyang*// gzhi yis so sor snang ba ltar// de bzhin grol bar chos mtshungs kyang*// gzhi dang yon tan dbang gis dbye// rang gi yon tan bskrun pa dang*// dpag yas 'byung po'i rten phyir sa// sangs rgyas nye dang sar zhugs dang*// sbyin la dga' bas rab dga'i sa// tshul khrims 'chal pa'i dri ma yis// ma gos phyir na dri ma med// lung gi chos kyi snang ldan zhing*// bzod mdangs ldan phyir 'od byed pa// rtog chos me yis nyes sreg cing*// brtson 'grus 'bar phyir 'od 'phro can// sbyang dka' gzhan sbyang bsam gtan gyis// rang sems bsrung phyir sbyang dka' ba// shes rab la brten 'khor 'das chos// mngon sum mthong bas mngon gyur sa// mtshan ma las ring thabs mchog gis// khyad par 'phags pas ring du song*// rtog pa kun gyis mi bsgul zhing*// smon lam legs gnas mi g.yo'i sa// stobs chen yang dag rig pa bzhis// chos ston phyir na legs pa'i blo// ting 'dzin gzungs sprin ye shes mkhar// 'du phyir de ni chos kyi sprin// de mthar ting 'dzin rdo rje yis// rin chen gter ni kha phye ste// de mthus de bzhi gnas bsgyur nas// bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan mdzod// sems can kun gyi gnyen gcig pu// sangs rgyas nyid ni 'thob par 'gyur// mkha' la sprin dpung dengs pa ltar// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun spangs nas// dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig pa// 'di ni rang bzhin sku ru bshad// dpag med thabs dang thugs rje'i mthus// zhing dang ston pa 'khor dang dus// nges pa'i chos dang bde chen la// longs spyod longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// 'di ni rang don bral ba yi// yon tan sum cu gnyis dang ldan// gnas dang gnas min mkhyen stobs dang*// las dang dbang po khams dang ni// mos dang kun 'gro dgod pa dang*// sngo gnas rjes su dran pa dang*// 'chi 'pho zag pa zad mkhyen pa// 'di dag thub pa'i stobs bcu ste// sgrib dang bdud kyi dkyil 'khor dang*// phas rgol 'joms la rdo rje mtshungs// spang ba dang ni ye shes dang*// nges 'byung lam dang de yi gags// yang dag ji bzhin ston pa la// kun tu 'jigs pa mi mnga'i phyir// mi 'jigs pa ni bzhi yin te// rgol ba sun 'byin bgyid pa dang*// gdul bya'i skye bo skyong ba la// rnam par bsgyings pa'i seng ge mtshungs// 'khrul dang ca tso mi mnga' dang*// bsnyel ba mi mnga' mnyam par gzhag

/tha dad pa yi 'du shes spangs// ma brtags btang snyoms mi mnga' dang*// 'dun pa dang ni brtson 'grus dang*// dran dang shes rab nyams mi mnga'// rnam grol rnam grol ye shes ni// kun du nyams pa mi mnga' dang*// sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi las// ye shes rjes su 'brang ba dang*// 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar la// sgrib med ye shes gzigs 'jug pa// 'di rnams thub pa'i ma 'dres chos// rnam pa bco brgyad nyid lags te// kun la khyab kyang thams cad kyis// ma gos phyir na mkha' dang mtshungs// 'di ni bral ba'i yon tan te// rnam par phye na bgrang yas lags// dbang bcu la sogs gzhan bshad pa// 'di yi nang du 'dus mkhyen mdzod// sku ni gzhan don rnam smin gyi// yon tan sum cu gnyis dang ldan// zhabs mnyam pa dang 'khor los mtshan// rting pa yangs dang sor mo ring*// drwa bas 'brel dang gzhon sha can// mdun mtho e na'i byin pa dang*// sba ba sbubs nub seng ge'i stod// thal gong rab rgyas dpung mgo zlum// phyag ring sku mchog rnam par dag /mgrin pa dri med dung lta bu// seng ge'i 'gram pa bzhi bcu'i tshems// thags bzang mnyam dang mche ba dkar// ljags ring ro bro'i mchog ldan dang*// ka la piṅka'i dbyangs dang ni// spyan mchog mthon mthing rdzi ma stug /mdzod spu rab tu dkar ba dang*// gtsug tor rab mtho bltar mi mthong*// pags pa srab cing gser mdog ldan// ba spu re re nas g.yas 'khrungs// dbu skra rin chen mthon mthing 'dra// n+ya gro dha ltar chu zhing gab// stobs po che yi mchog gyur pa// 'di dag sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan// dpe byad brgyad cu gang bshad pa// 'di las rnam par phye ba lags// 'di ni gzugs kyi sku yi dpal// ston ka yongs su dwangs pa la// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs pa// rgyu skar khrod na lham pa ltar// sa bcu brnyes pa'i dbus na lham// de nyid chu mtshor shar ba yis// byis pa dga' ba bskyed pa ltar// dge ba mthun par bsags pa la// mthun par snang bas de don bsgrub// 'di ni theg chen man ngag gi

/mdo yi rjes su 'brangs nas bshad// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de'i mthus// dpag yas 'gro ba'i bsod nams bzhin// sna tshogs snang bas don mdzad pa// de ni sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku// rang bzhin sku ni chos dbyings kyi// ye shes mchog gis bsdus pa ste// sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa ni// me long ye shes las gzhan min// mnyam pa nyid dang so sor rtog /de yi khyad par nyid lags shing*// bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyis// sangs rgyas sprul pa yang dag bsdus// sku dang ye shes de dag kyang*// rim bzhin rten dang brten pa dang*// de bzhin rang don gzhan don dang*// phra dang rags par rnam par gzhag /sangs rgyas de yang zag med kyi// dbyings dang ro gcig nyid phyir dang*// mi zad rgyu las bskrun phyir dang*// mi mthun phyogs kun bcom phyir dang*// smon lam nye bar grub phyir dang*// kun tu dbang 'byor brnyes phyir dang*// mdzad pa'i yul yang mi zad phyir// rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad pa lags// de phyir de yi bstan pa yang*// 'jig rten khams su rtag tu gnas// de la snang dang mi snang med// 'char ba dang ni nub pa dang*// 'phel dang 'grib par gang mthong ba// 'gro ba rnams kyi rtog pa dang*// las kyi dbang las byung ba ste// yul gyi mthu las de ma lags// ji ltar mkha' la snang ba dang*// mi snang ba dang nyi ma la// 'char dang nub par snang lags kyang*// de lta de ma lags pa bzhin// des na rnal 'byor dag pa la// rtag tu rgyal bas byin rlob cing*// dam chos bdud rtsi'i dga' ston la// rgyun du spyod pa ngo mtshar rmad// 'di ni theg pa chen po yi// chos kyi gleng ba mdo tsam lags// rgyas par gzhan du mkhyen bgyi ste// bla na med pa'i don chen slad// mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na// lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring*// lha dang mi yi them skas la// 'dzegs na thar pa gam na 'dug

/theg pa gsum gyis nges 'byung la// theg pa gcig gis 'bras bur gnas// zhes gsungs don gyi rim pa ltar// bdag gis 'di ni brjod pa lags// pha rol gzigs pa'i tshogs rnams dang*// shin tu mkhas pa de dag gis// rnam grangs du mas chos kyi tshul// yang yang gsal bar mdzad zin mod// nyung zhing gsal bas nyid thugs la// kun nas gdams par bgyi phyir dang*// gzhan dag la yang phan bgyi'i slad// bdag gis kyang ni 'dir brjod do// bdag blo byis pa'i ngang tshul dang*// shes bya rgya cher ma sbyangs dang*// glo bur bgyis phyir 'dir nongs pa// blo chen rnams kyis rtag bzod mdzod// dge ba de yis 'gro ba kun// 'jig rten tshul lugs legs spyad nas// dam chos bdud rtsi'i sgor zhugs te// kun kyang sangs rgyas nyid gyur cig /rgyal bu ji big la gtam du bya ba nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba me pho stag gi lo/ gdu bu'i zla ba'i tshes brgyad la/ 'phags pas dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o// tshigs su bcad pa nyis brgya dang bzhi bzhugs so/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
